name: m2_alternate_history_v1
source_assignment: Keep complete BaoStock symbol-method histories; replace each incomplete symbol-method history entirely with separately labelled Eastmoney reconstruction. Never mix periods inside a symbol-method history or overwrite BaoStock caches.
availability: Field-specific maximum NOTICE_DATE of required statements; strict signal date greater than availability. Missing dependencies create a missing event at current report notice, followed by a value only when every dependency is available. Never substitute UPDATE_DATE for NOTICE_DATE.
revision_policy: Vendor latest historical values, original announcement aligned, revision unknown. Keep UPDATE_DATE and flag updates after notice. Not historical-version PIT.
missing_source_period: Record source absence explicitly; no invented announcement date or zero value
invalid_dates: Retain and quarantine invalid source dates. Invalid rows outside planned report periods and required opening-equity dependencies cannot enter panels; any required invalid row blocks the build.
control_selection: 10 evenly spaced complete-history symbols in sorted symbol order, chosen without outcomes
cross_source_comparison: Descriptive per-field differences and publication-date differences on all overlap; do not claim exact substitution or tune formulas to improve agreement
completion: Every frozen request page succeeds or explicitly reports no data; every planned symbol-method-quarter is accounted for; all five full-scope panels independently replayed from raw inputs; coverage and cross-source differences disclosed. No new factor tests or protected-period access.
